es: A Rosa se le dan bien los idiomas.
why: A natural knack with a plural noun: se le dan bien.

en: I'm good at math. (I have built the skill over years)
why: A built up general skill is soy bueno para.

en: I could not bring myself to sing in front of everyone.
es: No fui capaz de cantar frente a todos.
why: Being able to do one particular thing, or not, is capaz de.
A natural knack is se me da bien.

en: Are you able to carry that box alone? (to a friend)
es: ¿Eres capaz de cargar esa caja solo?
why: One particular feat is ser capaz de.

en: Don Hernando is good at fixing motorcycles.
es: Don Hernando es bueno para arreglar motos.
why: Skill earned by practice is ser bueno para.

es: A Vale se le da bien cantar.
why: A knack that someone is given is se le da bien.

en: I couldn't bring myself to fire him.
why: A single hard act you could not do is capaz de.

en: Dancing does not come naturally to me.
es: No se me da bien bailar.
why: A missing knack is no se me da bien.
